text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Interior Minister Driss Basri attends Arab interior ministers council in Tunis which adopted common strategy against terrorism.
- Libyan Prime Minister Abdelmajid al-Gu'ud ends visit to Morocco with pledge to strenghten investment cooperation.
- Morocco and Libya seek raising level of bilateral trade.
- Moroccan NGOs launch national day against corruption.
- Consumer Price Index rose to 148.1 in November from 147.4 in October.
